# Prime Fleet Services (PFS)

> Elite Limousine Dispatch, Fleet Management, and Omnichannel BPO Services.

## About Prime Fleet Services
Prime Fleet Services (PFS) is a specialized Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and fleet technology support provider headquartered at WEBEL IT Park, Kalyanpur Satellite Township, Asansol, West Bengal, India. PFS delivers round-the-clock (24/7/365) limousine dispatching, global fleet monitoring, chauffeur coordination, booking reservation management, customer support, and tailored digital marketing solutions for luxury transportation providers and enterprise fleet operators across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **24/7 Limousine Dispatch**: Real-time dispatching, flight tracking, chauffeur scheduling, and active route supervision.
- **Reservation & Booking Management**: Seamless integration with Livery Coach, Limo Anywhere, Santa Cruz, and custom livery CRMs.
- **Omnichannel Guest Care**: Phone, live chat, SMS, and VIP concierge communication.
- **Fleet Telematics & Asset Tracking**: GPS geofencing, driver safety monitoring, vehicle telematics, and maintenance scheduling.
- **Digital Marketing for Fleet Operators**: High-conversion landing pages, local SEO, Google Ads management, and social media branding.
